follow-up time: Until the next event (stillbirth, miscarriage, or ectopic pregnancy) or censoring by live birth, death, emigration, or study end
cohort: 832,996 primiparous women with a live birth between January 1, 1982, and December 31, 2010
finding: Cesarean section is associated with a small increased rate of subsequent stillbirth and ectopic pregnancy.
